description.text: St. Urban is a town situated in the Gurktal Alps of north‑central Carinthia, Austria, lying about ten kilometres northeast of Feldkirchen and centred on St. Urban Lake.

The town’s terrain ranges from a low point of 520 metres in the Glan valley to a high point of 1,338 metres on the Hocheck, and it is surrounded by gently rolling hills such as the Gößeberg, Paulsberg and Illmitzer forest.

curiosities.text: The Dobra Moor, also known as Jakobi or Freundsamer moor, sits at an altitude of 902 metres and is home to a rare Nordic Birch, a relic from the ice age that was first discovered in Carinthia in 1922.
St. Urban Lake, a glacial lake that gives the town its name, is a notable feature of the local landscape.
